name: Ziel Home Furnishing Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: Ziel Home Furnishing Technology Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, design, and sale of home furnishing products in Europe, the United States, Canada, Latin America, and internationally. The company offers home storage and decor, outdoor garden supplies, and leisure and sports equipment; furniture products; and pet supply solutions for rest, travel, play, and pet waste management. It sells its products under the SONGMICS HOME, SONGMICS, VASAGLE, and Feandrea brands through online stores on e-commerce platforms.
